title: festuca rubra subsp. vulgaris
intro: Festuca rubra subsp. vulgaris, commonly known as red fescue, is a species of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra subsp. vulgaris include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
